CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid templates for [MangaPixer](https://github.com/dixit92/mangapixer), a self-hosted, folder-native comic and manga server with a fast web reader.
- **Install:** search for MangaPixer in Apps, or see the [Unraid install guide](https://github.com/dixit92/mangapixer/blob/main/docs/install-unraid.md). - **Documentation:** [docs](https://github.com/dixit92/mangapixer/tree/main/docs), including [How MangaPixer works](https://github.com/dixit92/mangapixer/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.md). - **Support:** open an issue on the [MangaPixer repository](https://github.com/dixit92/mangapixer/issues).
